scope: G-27 RE-02 / RE-06 / RE-07D adapter planning candidates only

adapter_ready_candidates.required_note: Use a generic, non-official search UI and broker-database abstraction. Do not use a real REINS screenshot, logo, or service-identifiable UI.

adapter_ready_candidates.proxy_type: broker DB panel / public portal card / property-card flow
adapter_ready_candidates.required_note: Plan generic broker DB and public portal panels with selected property-card flow. Avoid official branding and real/reference UI unless separately reviewed.
Plan simplified property cards, density control, and subtitle-safe lower band. No real listing photo or external asset is required.

adapter_ready_candidates.proxy_type: selected property sheet plus drawback marker
adapter_ready_candidates.required_note: Plan a selected property sheet and a drawback marker as abstract UI/document shapes. Do not introduce real listing screenshots.

adapter_ready_candidates.proxy_type: property sheet / editorial comparison / document-backed recommendation
adapter_ready_candidates.required_note: Anchor the curation value in property-document structure. Avoid pure lens, strategy diagram, or generic consulting visual treatment.

adapter_ready_candidates.proxy_type: AI recommendation panel plus property card
adapter_ready_candidates.required_note: Use an abstract AI panel and property card only. Do not use real AI product UI, logos, model screenshots, or identifiable recommendation services.
Plan symbolic risk markers for boundary, inheritance, and neighborhood issues. Do not use real maps, registry documents, or identifiable records unless later rights-reviewed.

adjustment_required_items.proxy_type: public information layer / non-public data bundle opacity contrast
adjustment_required_items.required_note: Before adapter planning, replace wall / gate / locked-room / security-facility / conspiracy-coded occlusion language with transparent layer contrast.
adjustment_required_items.exclusion_reason: Accepted meaning still needs representation adjustment before adapter planning.

deferred_adapter_blocked_items.rights_risk: low if abstract silhouettes are later approved; needs review if real person/cast assets are requested
deferred_adapter_blocked_items.required_note: Do not include in adapter planning. Deferred item blocks adapter planning until user chooses abstract silhouettes, real/cast asset, cut/reframe, or keeps it deferred.
deferred_adapter_blocked_items.exclusion_reason: Deferred item blocks adapter planning; this is distinct from asset_proxy_readiness_counts.blocked=0 in the gap report.

rollup.note: This list authorizes only adapter planning candidate selection. It does not authorize adapter IR, patch output, render, production timing, or creative acceptance.
